cross_verification.note_en: The Palestinian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates' consular services menu (mofa.pna.ps, directly accessed) lists passport issuance/renewal, civil-status transactions (birth certificate, character certificate, etc.), and powers-of-attorney as its consular services - no independent visa-issuance service page was found there or on any other official Palestinian government domain reached during this research. No official photo specification for a Palestinian-issued entry visa could be located or verified; all fields left unverified rather than sourced from third-party aggregator sites.
